title: Amtrak PIDS closeout receives mandatory recusal and append-only precedent controls
summary: Adjudicators disclose conflicts and recuse before voting; replacements preserve panel independence, precedent versions remain append-only and nonbinding, cross-panel consistency receives a reason-coded check, and appeal independence remains intact. Denominator: One recusal schema, thirty adversarial cases, eight bounded valid routes, twenty-two explicit rejections, and zero production conflicts, recusals, precedents, adjudications, or appeals.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Adjudicator conflict, recusal, precedent-versioning, and consistency controls.

Finding: Adjudicators disclose conflicts and recuse before voting; replacements preserve panel independence, precedent versions remain append-only and nonbinding, cross-panel consistency receives a reason-coded check, and appeal independence remains intact.
Denominator: One recusal schema, thirty adversarial cases, eight bounded valid routes, twenty-two explicit rejections, and zero production conflicts, recusals, precedents, adjudications, or appeals.
Boundary: Every disclosure, recusal, precedent, consistency check, and appeal fixture is synthetic.
Boundary: Precedent cannot rewrite prior decisions, assign blame, force an outcome, or substitute for current evidence and human review.
Boundary: A conflicted actor cannot vote or select its own replacement.
Next action: Require conflict disclosure and recusal for Amtrak PIDS closeout, version precedent append-only, and keep it nonbinding on blame, acceptance, and publication.
